subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “To her, it was better than a perfect sentence.”?
options: He had recorded a changing world, one day at a time.
Both need time, care, and someone willing to begin.
A living classroom changes every time students enter it.
It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a time.

本文沒有陳述「Both need time, care, and someone willing to begin.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A living classroom changes every time students enter it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「To her, it was better than a perfect sentence. It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「To her, it was better than a perfect sentence. It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a…」，答案為「It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a time.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a time.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
